proof_mechanism_legend.constructive: Real lambda/app proof term, transitive axiom closure ⊆ FOUNDATIONAL_AXIOMS.

proof_mechanism_legend.axiom_wrapper: Declaration::Theorem whose value references a same-type Declaration::Axiom. Not a proof.
proof_mechanism_legend.unchecked: Uses add_decl_structural or add_decl_unchecked; bypasses the type checker entirely.
proof_mechanism_legend.mixed: The conjecture has more than one mechanism across its theorems (e.g., some Eq.refl + some sorry-inhabited).

proof_mechanism_legend.hypothesis_wrapped: Declaration::Theorem whose statement is strengthened with an explicit local obligation, and whose proof returns or composes that local evidence instead of depending on a global domain axiom.
